owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

checkPool(address,uint256).notice: Reverts unless the pool's current price agrees with an independent reference.

quoteUsdFeeds(address,address,uint256).notice: Value of `amountIn` of `tokenIn` in `tokenOut`, from Chainlink USD feeds. 0 when either feed is missing.

referenceTick(address).notice: The reference tick used by {checkPool}, and whether one is available.

snapshot(address).notice: Records the pool's current price. Pools without a feed or TWAP history can act 1–30 minutes later         if the price is still about the same. Anyone may call it (the keeper does, hourly).
